title: astragalus onobrychis subsp. chlorocarpus
intro: Astragalus onobrychis subsp. chlorocarpus, commonly known as the Chlorocarpus milkvetch, is a plant species in the legume family that is native to certain regions of the world. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is believed to have a positive effect on the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus onobrychis subsp. chlorocarpus include anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
